svg.text: IGBT Low-Side Switching Circuit — MM75GAU65BKX driver schematic (rev C)
Kelvin-Emitter and Power-Emitter are separate nets on the board; they meet ONLY inside the Q1 die. Snubber spans Power-E and Collector only. Gate pulldown and TVS span Gate and Kelvin-E only.
D. GATE NETWORK (Gate to Kelvin-E only)
G. POWER LOOP (Brake-R, FW diode, bus terminals)
PLACE both decap caps within 5 mm of U1 P8/P5.
Both caps return to KELVIN_RETURN — never to POWER_GROUND.
Mount C_snub directly across Q1 P3/P4
+15 V rail, U1 P8, both decap top pins
Vee, U1 P5, decap bot pins, R_ge bot, TVS bot, Q1 P2
R_gate bot, R_ge top, TVS top, Q1 P1
PSU(−) 16AWG, Q1 P3, C_snub bot, D_fly P1 & P3
Q1 P4, R_snub bot, R_brake L
1. Kelvin-E and Power-E NEVER tie outside the die.
2. Driver decap caps within 5 mm of U1 P8/P5.
3. Twisted pair from U1 P6/P7 + P5 down to Q1 area.
4. C_snub straddles Q1 P3 ⌃ P4 directly (loop area < 2 cm²).
6. Bottom layer: continuous POWER_GROUND pour, 2 oz copper.
7. D_fly close to Q1; both anode pins (P1 + P3) tied to PGND.
8. R_brake pads spaced for resistor OR bus-bar jumper.
10. ≥ 0.5 mm clearance between any two non-GND nets.
11. ≥ 0.25 mm annular ring on every through-hole.
